title: 科学 · 7.13 LED 照明
source: 7.13 M1 物理讲座 25-28 · LED Lighting

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Listen to a talk in a physics class.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Imagine a time when the only lights available were flickering candles or oil lamps.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Now fast forward to today, when life is illuminated by the glow of energy-efficient LED lights.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: So what makes these tiny light-emitting diodes so revolutionary?

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: The first practical visible spectrum LED was developed in 1962.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: It was a breakthrough that altered the landscape of lighting technology and set us on a path toward reduced energy consumption.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: LEDs, short for light-emitting diodes, are a type of solid-state lighting.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: They use a semiconductor to convert electricity directly into light.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Unlike traditional incandescent bulbs, which waste a lot of energy as heat, LEDs are incredibly efficient.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: Their biggest benefit is that they use about 75% less energy than incandescent bulbs and last 25 times longer.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: That lowers electricity bills and also significantly reduces the carbon footprint.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: But the impact of LEDs goes beyond energy savings.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: They have enabled new designs that were previously unimaginable because of their small size, allowing LEDs to be integrated into flexible strips, smart bulbs, and even clothing.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: They also create possibilities in architecture, art, and everyday consumer products.

segments.speaker: 讲师
segments.text: With ongoing research, we could see LEDs that purify the air, improve mood through human-centric lighting, or even transform communication through Li-Fi, a wireless system that uses light from LEDs.
